card.name: Splitting intake into smaller, frequent portions
card.fires_on: Words in advice about spreading food or doses out: 'smaller' or 'frequently' before meals or doses, 'meals' after 'three main', and 'into' after 'divided'. Also the number 10 in exercise repetition counts.

modes.label: Smaller, more frequent meals or doses
modes.description: Words like smaller or frequently in advice to eat or dose in small, repeated amounts.
modes.example: If eating tires you, eat<< smaller>> meals more frequently.

modes.label: Dividing daily intake

modes.example: The daily intake of fat should be distributed over three main<< meals>>.

modes.description: The digit 0 in a count of repetitions such as 10x per side.
